test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

The expression of a wish that misfortune or doom befall a person
solution: The correct answer is: Curse [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Curse means a word or words expressing a wish that something terrible will happen to somebody. (एक शब्द या शब्द इच्छा व्यक्त करते हुए कि किसी के साथ कुछ भयानक होगा) • So, it is clear that 'Curse' can be used as a one-word substitute for '**The expression of a wish that misfortune or doom befall a person**' Therefore, the correct answer is option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Praise **means to say that somebody/something is good and should be admired. (यह कहना कि कोई / कुछ अच्छा है और उसकी प्रशंसा की जानी चाहिए) • **Blessing **means a prayer asking for divine protection, or a little gift from the heavens. (ईश्वरीय सुरक्षा के लिए प्रार्थना, या स्वर्ग से एक छोटा सा उपहार) • **Oath **means a serious promise that you will tell the truth or that you will do what you have said. (एक गंभीर वादा कि आप सच बोलेंगे या आपने जो कहा है वह करेंगे) 3e:T76e, The erroneous part of the sentence is: **explain the topic again**
